changes.comment: Finish events from the opencode and Pi bridges are delivered before the next event: each bridge derives when an event is finish from the dialect's lifecycle mappings — a fixed finish mapping always, a switch only for the field values whose case mapping is finish (or any value outside the cases when its otherwise is finish) — with every alias spelling, and hands those payloads to the hook command with spawnSync, whose exit or 5 s timeout releases the bridge (the timeout kills the shell, so a longer finish hook is cut off). A failed or timed-out synchronous send stays fail-open, other events keep the asynchronous spawn, and the opencode bridge still updates its currentSessionId memory for every event before the send. Pi's synchronous set gains agent_end and agent_settled next to session_shutdown.
